summary.text: Daniel Nguyen is a Democratic state representative from District 38 who has represented the district since January 9, 2023 and is seeking re-election.
He appears on the November 3, 2026 ballot with both Democratic and Republican nominations.

paragraphs.text: Daniel Nguyen was born in Camas, Washington, and founded and operated Bambuza Vietnam Kitchen.

He was elected to the Lake Oswego City Council in 2018, served as a director of the Immigration Counseling Service and Business for a Better Portland, and co-chaired the PCC School of Business & Entrepreneurship advisory committee.
